Create an OpenAdminOS agent (slug check-app-protection-policies-llm-scheduled, version 0.1.0, author Community/community) that reviews the tenant's app protection policies via /deviceAppManagement/managedAppPolicies and an LLM-written summary. Include both a manual and a scheduled trigger.

```yaml
descriptor:
  id: check-app-protection-policies-llm-scheduled
  name: Check app protection policies llm scheduled
  description: Reviews app protection policies and reports findings for admin review.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: apps
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_app_protection_policies
    format: graph
    label: Load app protection policies
    detail: Reads app protection policies from the active tenant.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /deviceAppManagement/managedAppPolicies
      select:
        - id
        - displayName
        - createdDateTime
        - lastModifiedDateTime
      scopes:
        - DeviceManagementApps.Read.All
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize findings with the active LLM
    detail: Generates a short app protection policies report.
    settings:
      system: >-
        You review app protection policies for Microsoft 365 admins. Be concise, factual, and
        conservative. Use only the supplied data.
      prompt: >-
        Total app protection policies: {{ load_app_protection_policies.output | size }}. Details: {{
        load_app_protection_policies.output }}. Write a compact report: main finding, what to
        verify, next actions.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 400
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
    - id: schedule
      kind: scheduled
      intervalSeconds: 86400
  result:
    summary: '{{ summarize.output.text | default("Summary unavailable.") }}'
    data:
      total: '{{ load_app_protection_policies.output | size }}'
      llmSummary: '{{ summarize.output.text }}'
```

Create an OpenAdminOS agent (slug audit-app-protection-policies-list-scheduled, version 0.1.0, author Community/community) that reviews the tenant's app protection policies via /deviceAppManagement/managedAppPolicies. Include both a manual and a scheduled trigger.

```yaml
descriptor:
  id: audit-app-protection-policies-list-scheduled
  name: Audit app protection policies list scheduled
  description: Reviews app protection policies and reports findings for admin review.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: apps
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_app_protection_policies
    format: graph

  result:
    summary: Reviewed {{ load_app_protection_policies.output | size }} app protection policies.
    data:
      total: '{{ load_app_protection_policies.output | size }}'
```

Draft a read-mode agent manifest with slug `audit-groups-count-sort-llm-scheduled` that loads groups from Graph (/groups, GET, scope Group.Read.All) selecting id, displayName, groupTypes, membershipRule, createdDateTime, breaks them down with a count transform, samples the oldest by createdDateTime, and summarizes with an llm skill. It should run manually and on a schedule. Author is "Community" (handle "community"), version 0.1.0.

```yaml
descriptor:
  id: audit-groups-count-sort-llm-scheduled
  name: Audit groups count sort llm scheduled
  description: Reviews groups and reports findings for admin review.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: policies
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_groups
    format: graph
    label: Load groups
    detail: Reads groups from the active tenant.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /groups
      select:
        - id
        - displayName
        - groupTypes
        - membershipRule
        - createdDateTime
      scopes:
        - Group.Read.All
  - id: count_by_grouptypes
    format: transform
    label: Count groups by groupTypes
    detail: Breaks groups down by groupTypes.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: '{{ load_groups.output }}'
      field: groupTypes
      buckets:
        - Unified
        - DynamicMembership
  - id: oldest_items
    format: transform
    label: Sample groups by createdDateTime
    detail: Lists groups ordered by createdDateTime.
    settings:
      kind: sort-by
      source: '{{ load_groups.output }}'
      field: createdDateTime
      direction: asc
      take: 10
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize findings with the active LLM
    detail: Generates a short groups report.
    settings:
      system: >-
        You review groups for Microsoft 365 admins. Be concise, factual, and conservative. Use only
        the supplied data.
      prompt: >-
        Total groups: {{ load_groups.output | size }}. Details: {{ count_by_grouptypes.output }}.
        Write a compact report: main finding, what to verify, next actions.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 400
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
    - id: schedule
      kind: scheduled
      intervalSeconds: 86400
  result:
    summary: '{{ summarize.output.text | default("Summary unavailable.") }}'
    data:
      total: '{{ load_groups.output | size }}'
      breakdown: '{{ count_by_grouptypes.output }}'
      sample: '{{ oldest_items.output }}'
      llmSummary: '{{ summarize.output.text }}'
```

Create an OpenAdminOS agent (slug check-service-principals-sort-llm, version 0.1.0, author Community/community) that reviews the tenant's service principals via /servicePrincipals and an LLM-written summary.

```yaml
descriptor:
  id: check-service-principals-sort-llm
  name: Check service principals sort llm
  description: Reviews service principals and reports findings for admin review.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: policies
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_service_principals
    format: graph
    label: Load service principals
    detail: Reads service principals from the active tenant.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /servicePrincipals
      select:
        - id
        - displayName
        - appId
        - accountEnabled
        - servicePrincipalType
      scopes:
        - Application.Read.All
  - id: oldest_items
    format: transform
    label: Sample service principals by displayName
    detail: Lists service principals ordered by displayName.
    settings:
      kind: sort-by
      source: '{{ load_service_principals.output }}'
      field: displayName
      direction: asc
      take: 10
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize findings with the active LLM
    detail: Generates a short service principals report.
    settings:
      system: >-
        You review service principals for Microsoft 365 admins. Be concise, factual, and
        conservative. Use only the supplied data.
      prompt: >-
        Total service principals: {{ load_service_principals.output | size }}. Details: {{
        load_service_principals.output }}. Write a compact report: main finding, what to verify,
        next actions.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 400
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
  result:
    summary: '{{ summarize.output.text | default("Summary unavailable.") }}'
    data:
      total: '{{ load_service_principals.output | size }}'
      sample: '{{ oldest_items.output }}'
      llmSummary: '{{ summarize.output.text }}'
```
